body:

- A non-commercial or small-scale actor falls below that threshold, where litigation cost is not justified by what could be collected.

- Case: DMCA. A non-monetised AI aggregation project on personal infrastructure draws automated DMCA takedowns when verbatim text is accidentally pulled rather than publisher lawsuits.
